depth_convention: 0 = input of block 1; l = output of block l (l = 1..12); '12+LN' = after the final LayerNorm. The paper's Fig. 14 uses layer indices 0-11 (decoding, R2) and 1-12 (stable rank) without saying which is which.

probe.method: ridge least squares on centred one-hot targets, closed form from the normal equations accumulated in float64; test features stored as float16

coords_2d.note: 256 x 2 PCA coordinates (U S) of the centred position matrix, row-major 16 x 16 grid: index p = 16 * row + column

paper_values_for_comparison.source: read off Fig. 14 of arXiv:2510.08638v3 (see NOTES.md); ImageNet-1k, not Imagenette
